stories.title: Facade Input/Output Schema and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define canonical request/response schemas including unified envelope (status, data, errors) to standardize outputs across clinical trials and provider detail, ensuring compatibility with tool_router.

stories.title: Core Orchestration Logic for Trials and Provider Detail
stories.description: Implement facade orchestration logic that routes requests to clinical_trials_service and provider_detail_service, aggregates results, and normalizes outputs into a unified response structure.

stories.title: Tool Router Integration for Evaluate Care Facade
stories.description: Expose facade capabilities via tool_router with explicit tool schemas, allowlist registration, and consistent response envelope for LLM consumption.

stories.title: Facade Error Handling and Response Normalization
stories.description: Implement cross-domain normalization ensuring clinical trials and provider detail outputs conform to a shared envelope and consistent error taxonomy, including fallback handling.

stories.title: Facade Unit and Integration Tests
stories.description: Develop unit and integration tests validating facade orchestration, schema compliance, tool_router invocation, and error scenarios across both clinical trials and provider detail flows.
